- If Wed 11th 14:00 UTC works, that gives Sato the earliest overlap with Tokyo in late evening. If you'd prefer morning for London, Thu 12th 08:00 UTC is fine as well.

I'm happy to run the session; Marissa from our solutions team will join for the technical Q&A and run the dedicated-capacity cost primer.

Hi all,

Quick heads-up from Tokyo side: Nov 11–13 we have company-wide leave for Diwali (floating/local leave this year) and several engineers will be OOO. Nov 11 evening UTC will unfortunately not work for most of our infra team.

Can we look at Mon Nov 15 or Tue Nov 16 UTC windows instead? Mornings in Tokyo (09:00–11:00 JST) would be ideal for our engineers — I think that maps to late night/early morning UTC, so something like 00:30–02:00 UTC could work on those dates. Alternately, we can do Nov 15 08:30 UTC (shorter session) if that’s less painful for the EU folks.

Sorry for the late notice — Diwali dates changed slightly for our local office this year. Also: small ask — when you send an invite, please include explicit timezone names (e.g., Europe/London, Asia/Tokyo) rather than just offsets; our calendars mis-handle DST conversions sometimes.

Best,
Sato
Lead Platform Engineer, Acme Japan
